note: Art whose name gives away where it is. Kept for a later question that shows a picture and asks where it is.

places.name: Karl X Gustav (Stortorget)
places.why: Equestrian statue in the middle of Stortorget since 1896; the city's best-known monument and most-read art article on sv Wikipedia.

places.name: Optimistorkestern
places.why: Lundell's bronze marching band on Södergatan (not Stortorget or Lilla torg), a standard meeting point on the main pedestrian street.

places.name: Arbetets ära (Möllevångstorget)
places.why: Axel Ebbe's group of naked workers lifting a granite block, the landmark of Möllevångstorget.

places.name: Fontänerna på Gustav Adolfs torg (Fem fontäner och ett klot)
places.why: Sivert Lindblom's five bronze fountains and granite sphere on Gustav Adolfs torg, burning fire in winter; the square's focal point.

places.name: Torgbrunn (fontänen på Stortorget)
places.why: Stig Blomberg's 1964 bronze fountain on Stortorget, the second fixed point on the main square after the statue.

places.name: Ekotemplet (Pildammsparken)
places.why: The round columned temple from the 1914 Baltic Exhibition in Pildammsparken, a well-known meeting and photo spot.
